## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle text by [瞿曇般若流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9E%BF%E6%9B%87%E8%88%AC%E8%8B%A5%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) Gautama Prajñāruci is a Mahāyāna sūtra featuring the legendary Indian sage *Pí yē suō* 毘耶娑 (Vyāsa, the redactor of the *Mahābhārata* and the *Vedas*) as the bodhisattva-inquirer. The Buddhist appropriation of Vyāsa as a Buddhist sage-figure is unusual and reflects the broader inter-religious dialogue between Buddhism and Brahmanical traditions in mid-first-millennium India.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Prajñāruci's Eastern-Wèi period (538 – 543 CE).

The Taishō text (T0354) is established on the standard apparatus.
